scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --kill-others --success first "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.migrate: sh -c 'if [ -z "${DATABASE_URL:-}" ]; then docker compose up -d --wait db; fi && sh scripts/dev-api.sh init'
scripts.predev: docker compose up -d --wait db && sh scripts/dev-api.sh init
